question: Will BTC Be Above $90K at 00:00 UTC on September 27, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC-USD on Coinbase spot price is strictly above $90,000 at 00:00 UTC on September 27, 2026.
- "No": Wins if the BTC-USD on Coinbase spot price is $90,000 or below at 00:00 UTC on September 27, 2026.
